description: Hand a Python task (read, change and test code) to an assistant that specializes in Python; it reads and edits files and runs tests itself, then returns its report and a diff of changed files. It cannot see your conversation, so write the task in full. Errors: ArgumentsBad, DirBad.

task.description: the task: which files, what to change, how to tell it is done (e.g. which test must pass)

dir.description: the folder it may touch, relative to your workspace (default . = the whole workspace)
